obligations.scope: Optional sufficient candidate, stronger than ordinary unimodality; all interior ranks. Not implied by unimodality. A refutation does not refute the unification objective or Erdos 993.
obligations.statement: For every finite forest F and every integer 0 < k < alpha(F), at the unique activity lambda > 0 with E_lambda K = k, D_lambda(k) = (lambda + 1/lambda) P_lambda(K=k) - P_lambda(K=k-1) - P_lambda(K=k+1) is strictly positive.

obligations.scope: Candidate sufficient lemma at the public analytic rank window, with no vertex floor. Existing public n>=61 branch is guidance, not a new ordinary-axiom award. Distinct from the all-interior claim.
obligations.statement: For every finite forest F on n vertices, every integer ceil(n/4) < k < h_beta(F), at activity lambda > 0 with E_lambda K = k, D_lambda(k) > 0; beta(x)=(1+2x)^nu(1+x)^(n-2nu), nu the maximum matching size, and h_beta the first mode.
